notes.title: Summer Development Update from Drinkbox Studios
notes.content:
[p]Hey! How’s it going? 
[/p][p]Eating well? Sleeping in? Folding clothes? [/p][p]That’s so great to hear.[/p][p][/p][p]- Oh, us? Nah, we haven’t been up to much. [/p][p]Well, except for all the work we’ve put into our new game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2974160/Blighted/"][u]Blighted[/u][/url]. Check it out![/p][p][/p][p]As you know, we [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2974160/announcements/detail/533226373233248985"][u]announced[/u][/url] Blighted back in June as part of [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9JHPGemT0gI&ab_channel=thegameawards"][u]Summer Game Fest 2025[/u][/url], and we’ve been hard at work on it since. (Thanks for wishlisting it, by the way. It really does help 🙏)[/p][p][/p][p]We don’t want to spoil too much, buuuut we’ve added a TON of enemies to the game, and are still adding more! Each of them deadly in their own weird and freaky little way.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcGirw8Xgso8NdeflBw5tE3v9twKbLroA8soxm1P_mNAdGmdkZ5C9_bJyPOj2GZDyuTPcmwgHdYx6G8IqpUKWSmOjzHdpvdjUPkOhc04Oza7_x-x0lJfhnmYhKJKRH3fZxsfhy88A?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p]It’s hard to believe but we actually built out an early version of the entire game as part of an internal-alpha milestone! And right now we’re in the middle of tearing it all up, choosing the best bits, adding juicy challenges and putting it all back together again.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcB7WNc_ID7rJSXKc1JFCllZP1WG7931zeX0LzGzcbE39r41XNQEUhoFPC5fPW3r2ME0EwTgIr5yNacpA3YQVbiCgsbbN0d3VURjWpuC0UxvbzdqJl4Kz1GFr88HvST0So6Vln-3Q?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p]Now, it might sound like we don’t have much left to do, but that couldn’t be further from the truth! We’re still fine tuning the gameplay and combat loop to go beyond the standard we’ve established in any of our other games thus far. Blight is getting deadlier, and gnarlier too. Our programmers are working all sorts of technical magic to make Blighted shine, ooze and wriggle. And every new object in the game is another opportunity for our artists to draw up a fresh nightmarish creation to populate the growing world. And Jim Guthrie is still sending us tracks that put shivers down our spines in all of the best ways.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdS_wktGXW5cZQpDDjZt3wW6YyMfT8JOuDx3nTPCVZ09bmpu-1zeVOE7mKbCfz3RxLrI_0weblRZDYIhxJnt5lL6L0ZvElUxzM4LaMA6zo8hz-WDj0LxC1uAYI-FOXRAFfLqGL8vg?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're also prepping the soundtrack from Tales from Space: Mutant Blobs Attack to be released on Steam very soon! As one of our first major releases, Mutant Blobs Attack will always hold a special place in our ears - because the soundtrack by Peter Chapman and Shaun Hatton is SO GOOD. If you ever need a shot of caffeine directly into your earlobes, load up this soundtrack, sit back, and get back up again because your toes will not stop tapping.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcLSBqlew1oYLAN1HV9oezPGECMjlVP1r4NB60tS529tzdSypMl_0bJVfLRJZz_hjtCOLy1nLpgeY7kSNurU6ldRLcLNQ3oz2_pudPhbuFnB3ZoxyzqBpNN0xonYoR_d-smP7VDZQ?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p]On the more human side, we recently took the team out to get their quarterly quota of exercise by running, jumping, dodging, ducking, dipping, diving, dodging, throwing, shooting (basketball), shooting (gun) and yelling with [url="http://playactivate.com"][u]Activate[/u][/url]. We then gathered for our biggest team photo to date!! (we’re still missing an international co-worker or two, but we’ll get them one day!)[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeGWP9bjPXc4TEF92lcb1cSn1rR7NMcd0_by5CbjprrIM9GQYpW25AntKL0Bb19xy4CZGFkhEORf8QcQ8pXc_6JxiaBuTCzExVvUUCiAWpYA4fbJlkbls86-kz4bFPP_1RkQSmY?key=ufPMY9caO1Pf00_ctoTGWQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Huh. Turns out we have in fact been ‘up to much’! Sorry for all the yapping. As a thank you for listening, we’ve put [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/drinkbox/list/48544"][u]all of our games[/u][/url] on sale on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]Catch you later![/p][p]The Drinkbox Team[/p]

notes.title: Happy Holidays from Drinkbox Studios
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/002999d6b6cc90990cfb62b28377ed799cf7a452.png[/img]

Happy Holidays! 2023 was a relatively quiet year for us as we’ve been heads-down, working on some new ideas… but we still wanted to share some highlights from the past year!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/ba07ac9e7634dbde752899bf0618bf198c826a59.png[/img]

In January we released a free update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432050/Nobody_Saves_the_World/]Nobody Saves the World[/url] which featured Magic Jimmy’s Impossible Dungeon and a new unlockable Dinosaur form. We were overwhelmed with the positive response to this update and loved seeing photos of your statue gardens!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/8f6eee9b4374c296186f877c15cbb034520008e2.jpg[/img]

This year we added some new members to our team including 3D Technical Artist Greg and Junior Programmer Fred. We also welcomed back Animator and Artist Matheus who worked with us on Nobody Saves the World!

Speaking of our team, here are some of their favourite games played in 2023:
[list]
[*] Cass: Nioh, Dragon's Dogma, Remnant 2
[*] Fred: Paradise Marsh, Risk of Rain Returns, Plate Up
[*] Gabby: Zelda TOTK, Baldur’s Gate 3, Dave the Diver, Slay the Princess
[*] Graham: Baldur's Gate 3, Zelda TOTK, Mario Wonder
[*] Greg: Lethal Company
[*] Ian: Time Crisis 4, Cobalt Core, Kane & Lynch 2: Dog Days
[*] Josh: Hi-Fi Rush, Mario Wonder
[*] Matheus: Alan Wake 2, Spider-man 2, Elden Ring
[*] Mau: Mario Wonder, Zelda TOTK, Metroid Prime
[*] Mike: Baldur's Gate 3, Armored Core VI, Cyberpunk 2077
[*] Ryan: Dungeons & Dragons (pen and paper)
[*] Steele: Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades, Victoria 3, RimWorld
[*] Vlad: Counter-Strike 2, Squad, Spider-Man 2, Armored Core VI
[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/45fbd48875f82292a86d5a067a18e4a8b09a6161.png[/img]

Here are some highlights from the past year:

🥇 Nobody Saves the World was nominated for a bunch of awards, including the Canadian Screen Awards, Canadian Game Awards, and Webby Awards. We didn’t win any of these, buuuuut…

🏆 [url=https://jimguthrie.bandcamp.com/]Jim Guthrie[/url] won the Screen Composers Guild of Canada award for “Best Original Score for Games and Interactive Media” for the Nobody Saves the World soundtrack!

💿 Jim also released the Nobody Saves the World soundtrack on a beautiful double vinyl

🐓 We teamed up with [url=https://theyetee.com/collections/drinkbox-studios]The Yetee[/url] to release new Nobody Saves the World and Guacamelee merch, including this [url=https://theyetee.com/collections/drinkbox-studios/products/pollo-power]very good spinning pollo pin[/url]

💖 We partnered with [url=https://limitedrungames.com/]Limited Run Games[/url] to release physical versions of Nobody Saves the World, Severed, and Mutant Blobs Attack (which sold out almost immediately!)

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/56605bcb2d046e74eeb5fd36d2515cf140f33bd5.jpg[/img]

Over this past year we’ve been busy prototyping new stuff, playing with new ideas and styles. We’ve landed on something the whole team is very excited about, something completely new to us that we hope you’ll be excited about too.

We can’t wait to share more when we can, but in the meantime here’s a lil sneaky peek ^

Consider [url=http://discord.gg/drinkbox]joining our discord[/url] to keep updated on the latest news about all our games (including this new one)

- - - 

Thank you for all your support over this past year! We really couldn’t have done it without you and appreciate your support.

Happy Holidays, 
Signed, [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@drinkbox/video/7195583559825034501?lang=en]Matthew DrinkBox[/url]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/6863330/73b631387be9db8f8ae622dae5a5d308636b509d.png[/img]

Pssssst, a bunch of our games are ON SALE for the holiday season! These are usually the steepest discounts we do all year, so there’s never been a better time to pick them up:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1432050/Nobody_Saves_the_World/ 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/534550/Guacamelee_2/ 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/275390/Guacamelee_Super_Turbo_Championship_Edition/

notes.title: Say hello to our new game, Nobody Saves The World!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/0f8c42ef35783030705ad32cf799bbaac8508ab5.jpg[/img]

We’re excited to announce our brand new game Nobody Saves The World, an Action RPG where you transform into different unique character classes, including a 🐁, a 🐎, a 🧙‍♂️, a 🧜, a 🐉, an 🥚, and a 🐢!

Here’s what people are saying about the game so far:
[list]
[*] [i]“Blending the humor of the studio’s past games with the developers’ penchant for upending classic genre ideas, the opening missions of Nobody I played hint at a fascinating, funny, and fulfilling RPG adventure.”[/i] Jonathon Dornbush, [b]IGN[/b]

[*] [i]“It's pacy and fluid, slick, but light. It's great, and a good example of what this studio's all about. A layer of loveable goof, at ground level, that soon gives way to a much deeper well of combat, and systems, and a quiet mastery of genre.”[/i] Chris Tapsell, [b]Eurogamer[/b]

[*] [i]“One dungeon I explored was a crashed UFO site, whose stranded occupants needed me to sweep the area of monsters and get the power back on, for example. It’s a DrinkBox production, after all, where you can almost see the developers’ whiteboard with a zillion ideas written on it.”[/i]  Owen S. Good, [b]Polygon[/b]
[/list]

Nobody Saves the World is COMING SOON to PC! Wishlist us on Steam and be notified when the game launches:

notes.title: DrinkBox Studios 2020 Year in Review
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Holidays! [/h1]

Wow… 2020 sure was a year, huh? 😅 Despite, well you know *gestures broadly*, we’re very fortunate to have had a pretty good year at DrinkBox and wanted to take some time to look back, reflect on the year, and share some highlights.

When COVID-19 hit back in March, the city of Toronto went into full lockdown and the whole DrinkBox team transitioned to working remotely from home. There was definitely an adjustment period as we set up our respective home offices, switched to using Discord for our daily stand ups and meetings, and got used to our new co-workers -- ie. our cats and dogs and plants, who were especially excited about this working-from-home we were all doing. We’ve since settled into a nice flow with the whole team working together remotely, and now we have a new Friday night ritual of playing games together via Discord, which is a nice thing to come out of this whole lockdown thing.

Speaking of which, here are some of our team’s favourite games they played in 2020:

[list]
[*] Cass: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/418530/Spelunky_2/]Spelunky 2[/url]
[*] Gabby: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145360/Hades/]Hades[/url]
[*] Graham: Crosscode
[*] Ian: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/601150/Devil_May_Cry_5/]Devil May Cry 5[/url]
[*] Josh: Rocket League
[*] Kaitlin: Animal Crossing New Horizons
[*] Mayuran: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145360/Hades/]Hades[/url], Factorio
[*] Mike: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145360/Hades/]Hades[/url], Demon's Souls remake
[*] Steph: Astro’s Playroom
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/e09cc99d67cef11765527075417eb776b263d82c.jpg[/img]

While we didn’t have any new releases in 2020 ourselves, we did have some exciting Guacamelee! news to come out of this year: 

[list]
[*] The Guacamelee! One Two Punch Collection was released in Europe!
[*] Juan made a cameo in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/860900/Bounty_Battle/]Bounty Battle[/url], along with several other indie game protagonists
[*] NOW Magazine named Guacamelee! one of their Top 10 Toronto-made Games (a lot of great games are made in Toronto so we’re very honoured!!)
[*] We partnered with Ship to Shore to create TWO vinyl records for both Guacamelee! and Guacamelee! 2! [url=https://shiptoshoremedia.com/search?q=guacamelee]You can pre-order them both here[/url]
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/e4592e96848a07f6104e840717cb651c22887994.jpg[/img]

We also teased our upcoming unannounced game which we’ve been working hard on over this past year. It’s a brand new IP we’re very excited for, and can’t wait to share more about it with you in 2021 👀

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/6ded4ab0ad2ca0444f7df75638012b1c442135aa.gif[/img]

To help us develop this brand new game we’re working on, we added 2 new people to the DrinkBox team, including Josh Davis our QA Tester and Kaitlin Smith our Associate Producer!  

Hey actually, did you know we’re currently hiring for 2 additional roles including Senior Programmer and Game Tester? If you’re interested in applying [url=http://drinkboxstudios.com/blog/careers/]check out the job listings here.[/url] We’d love to have you on the team!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/be33a602d76a0c292d38a8c556623ad086f43b4d.jpg[/img]

Thanks for all your support in 2020. We hope you’re doing well and continuing to stay safe and that 2021 will be a much better year for everyone.

Happy Holidays, from your pals at DrinkBox studios

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/9b28e0ecdff02c966e55e6359c42274a00944e0c.jpg[/img]

By the way, all of our games are on sale for up to 80% OFF during the Holiday! These are the steepest discounts we do all year, so there’s never been a better time to pick up our games:

notes.title: Lunar New Year + 'The Journey to Guacamelee 2'
notes.content:
Hello everyone, a couple of quick updates:
[list]
[*] Guacamelee! 2 is on sale now as part of the Lunar New Year Sale. Happy Lunar New Year!
[*]We've created a new "complete-the-set" Guacamelee! 2 bundle containing the game plus its OST and all DLC content!  This has been set up so that (in Steam's words): "If you already own some of the products in the bundle, purchasing it will allow you to 'complete the set', paying only for the products you don't already own while still receiving the full bundle discount on each of those products."
[/list]
Last but not least: Drinkbox Concept Design Lead Augusto Quijano recently wrote up some of his thoughts on his experience working on Guac2, along with a few examples of ideas that *didn't* quite make it to the final game. Read on below if you're curious to hear more.

--- [i]ːsteamhappyː Warning: Light spoilers ahead! ːsteamhappyː[/i] ---

[h1]Learning to Guac: The Journey to Guacamelee 2[/h1]

¡Hola amigos! This is Augusto Quijano, Concept Lead at Drinkbox Studios. In case you don’t know anything about me (you probably don’t!) I’ve been working in the games industry since 2009, focusing mainly on concept art/design and animation. I was born and raised in Mexico, and moved to Canada after high school to pursue a degree in Animation. Shortly after graduating, I joined the team at Drinkbox Studios, and pitched the crazy idea of making a game based on luchadores, which ultimately became Guacamelee!

Guacamelee! was a labour of love and a big success for us at Drinkbox, and we’ve spent the past couple of years working on a sequel.  Now that it's out, I thought it’d be fun to look back on what we’ve learned -- or thought we’d learned -- since we started.

When I think back on the early days of Guacamelee, it always seems to be as weird and wild as the talking chickens in the game itself. We were just so excited! For me it was that naiveté that made me feel invincible. That, and an overwhelming sense of nostalgia about my home country. Guacamelee takes place in a fantastically absurd version of Mexico, and is meant to show all of its color, glory, folklore and, you know, that Mexico is more than cartel wars and cactus shade nappers.

When creating the original game, we had to figure out a lot of problems, like making a combat system inspired by wrestling, enemy variety, platforming challenges, a visual lexicon to keep the game clear yet colorful, and many other challenges. Many things were tried and dropped. Thankfully, the game resonated with all of you, and we were so happy all of that effort meant something for the players. So when the idea to do the sequel started to become a reality, it was like smelling that pulled pork sandwich at 5 a.m. at your friend's wedding. We jumped at that [i]torta[/i].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/0c55297c7bd1670323906e9572435a227f1cb6a8.jpg[/img]

If life can teach you something, it’s that the more you learn, the more you realize how much more there is left to learn! I was feeling confident that my naiveté entering into the development of the first game would not be an issue on the sequel. "We've done this before". All of the major problems were solved already, we've even done a successful sequel before (shoutout to Mutant Blobs Attack!) -- how naive of me...

Turns out Guacamelee 2 was quite a challenging project! We realized we needed to make the game better, more engaging, finer tuned. And, in the end, I think we succeeded. The experience has better flow, it's ambitious but stays grounded, it's bigger but better paced, the upgrade system has more depth, the art direction was taken up a notch. For the untrained eye these changes might be a bit invisible, but these were complex problems and -- ok sorry, I'm tooting my own [i]trompeta[/i].

I want to share some examples, though, of things we [i]couldn’t[/i] figure out that got left on the cutting room floor. Not all of our shots are going to be golazos, but failed bicycle kicks are still very entertaining.  So, for your enjoyment, here’s a behind-the-scenes peek at a few of our failed ideas from Guacamelee! 2. 

[b]Cabezón’s Pontoon[/b]

We had an idea to have a waterfall as a point of no return, featuring a studio favorite: Cabezón in his pontoon. I did a quick flash animation to illustrate the story beat for it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/93bfb0d5072d83cf8ba05d4c720b78d79b466cfb.gif[/img]

We had planned to cut Pueblucho out of the map here, but later we realized it would be better (and metroidvania-er) to have the Darkest Timeline version of Pueblucho as a place the player  could revisit. Sadly Cabezón's pontoon was relegated to a dialogue mention, but his love for boating is still a core character trait in our hearts.

[b]The General, Coscorrona Sisters and The Handler[/b]

The bosses in Guacamelee are quite extravagant characters, and their complex nature makes them very challenging to design. Before our beloved Muñeco came to dazzle us with magic tricks, or Cactuardo teamed up with the [i]Bird-who-must-not-be-named[/i], we had [i]The General[/i], the other [i]Coscorrona Sisters[/i], and [i]The Handler[/i]. Well we never really "had" them. We couldn't make them fully work for one reason or another...

[i]General Huesitos[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/6144d7e728be79cdac88660e0d4b44aaa5787608.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/5a137e2264c3e32c79e37a9870c0bc68952f8115.jpg[/img]

General Huesitos was a dead dictator who stole an enormous golden machete from a giant. He died when a cannonball smashed into his face. I love that visual, but for various reasons he didn't make the cut. Only his machete did (as Muñeco's melee weapon of choice).

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/4c3970588def07e11b5bda638e38796afc6101fc.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/d1090450646abb77e3c2566f5779bc40674df295.jpg[/img][/url]

[i]Coscorrona Sisters[/i]

The third Boss in the game was the hardest to design, as they needed to play a role in parts of the story which were still taking shape. Eventually we settled on Zope as an antagonist for the Chicken Illuminati, having teamed up with the monstrous Cactuardo. But, that didn't stop us from endless trial-and-error with his design. 

Before we had settled on the Zope/Cactuardo pair, we experimented with the idea of a pair of boxing twin sisters who could transform into Giants. They were the Coscorrona sisters. Later in production we rescued one of them for Coscorrona, the grappling trainer!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/dbc040b522e10a12deff291cdc1fd2030d24e615.jpg[/img]

Oh, and there was a third Coscorrona sister, who died after overusing her ability to transform into a giant.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/1a3e46fdb758367c3f70e7aeb185393de22d057d.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/0e30eb09a878ac2a3cfe74db5aafe991792c0008.jpg[/img][/url]

[i]Cactuardo and The Handler[/i]

We experimented with Cactuardo too -- a character who himself had been concepted then set aside in Guacamelee 1! At first we were toying with the idea of a mystery handler in charge of him.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/6cf3ca40edcd0aefc300a8251faed229c5d9a1e0.jpg[/img]

Eventually, as I mentioned, Zope took the role of Cactuardo’s partner, and helped us tie up the narrative with the Illuminati subplot.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/20117a21ab2186f540b0f6ea48df7f089b6d1866.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6863330/f971afd872dcbe2cb3ed9fcd648c80eff3fa6b1d.png[/img][/url]

I hope you enjoyed some of the behind the scenes images in here, and I truly hope you enjoy playing Guacamelee 2! I'm very proud of what the team has accomplished and on a personal note I'm thrilled to have a game with a Latin American protagonist and cast.

[i]¡Órale![/i]

notes.title: New DLC out today, and more to come!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It’s been a few months since the launch of Guacamelee! 2, and we’re super honoured by the critical reception and the support from our fans. We haven’t just been kicking back and frantically refreshing review sites though - we’ve been busy since August, and today we’re finally ready to show off some fun new extras!

[h1]The ‘Three Enemigos’ Character Pack - out TODAY![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/2753e31b86a7eabfd53dbe05dafc58e7dee6a456.gif[/img]

As of right now, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/942540/Guacamelee_2__Three_Enemigos_Character_Pack/]you can purchase this character pack[/url] to play Guacamelee! 2 as three of the game’s beloved bosses - El Muñeco, Uay Pek or Jaguar Javier. Each new character skin has unique gameplay pluses and minuses to change up your playthrough, as well as associated achievements you can earn.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/787beb1486c95f1db17de38a21260b0b964bc255.gif[/img]


[h1]‘The Proving Grounds’ Challenge Level - coming early December![/h1]

And next month we have something even bigger:

This DLC pack introduces a new challenge level, The Proving Grounds - a floating temple and home to the god Tiempochtli, where luchadores have gone since the beginning of time to sharpen their skills. Your five lucha trainers team up to guide you through a series of challenges, and each trainer is ready to award you with a character skin that lets you play the game as that trainer. Like the Enemigos, their costumes have unique gameplay attributes suited to the trainer’s specialty. Flame Face does higher and higher damage the greater your combo grows; Uay Coco’s magic lets him execute many special moves, but his body is extra-vulnerable to damage (and he makes for a pretty adorable ‘chicken’).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/4ca3fdb0e09868166ae90d2d4d3fad87e5dfa9c3.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/a04ffe3f4a9d38e59c50b1ff1e250319e51ecb01.gif[/img]

We set our designers loose to fill the level with 15 ridiculously fun challenges that push the limits of Juan’s capabilities in new ways. Once you’ve mastered them and earned gold medals across the board, you’ll meet Tiempochtli and receive one final (secret) character skin reward.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/19ee86579a7b2f2868aa980d7630c8ee144a14fb.gif[/img]

We can’t wait to hear what you think of it! :g2heart:

notes.title: Guacamelee! 2 - Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Late last year, we announced that Guacamelee! 2 would be released… “soon-ish.” Well, soon-ish has almost arrived at Drinkbox Studios!

We’re thrilled to announce that Guacamelee! 2 will launch for Steam on August 21st for $19.99 USD. Check out the new launch trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5Y5n_oHsR9Q

The original Guacamelee! launched in April of 2013. It’s now over five years later and the game still stands as the definitive Mexican-Folklore-Inspired-Luchador-Platform-Brawler-Metroidvania! How do we top that?

[h1]More Chicken![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/e107c62c6b90164fd67dcd57167919b726454549.jpg[/img]

The power of the pollo reigns supreme throughout Guacamelee! 2.

Small tunnel to traverse? Turn into a chicken and strut right on through.

Giant purple block in your way? Pollo Shot and smash that bad boy to bits.

Wait… what’s that? An orange block? Smash it with an expertly executed Pollo Slide.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/1d115387a9491c838d13afc0e874e5725b4d9ac1.png[/img]

Pollo Shot against bouncy walls and ricochet yourself a rapid path to freedom.

Experience the full glory of Pollo Glide by using air currents to reach unprecedented heights!

But what if the entire fabric of the Mexiverse is at risk of collapsing in on itself? No problem. Stumble upon a secret society of prophetic chickens and prove your worth. Could JUAN be the fabled CHICKEN-MAN!?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/0bce691e898948f37c3687e96601b54c29aee385.jpg[/img]

As you can well imagine, these new chicken moves aren’t just for busting your way into exotic new locations. Pollo combat is frantic, furious and fabulous.

In fact, there’s so much new chicken gameplay and content in Guacamelee! 2 that we embedded a genre-busting Pollovania completely inside of the main story’s Metroidvania. The only such game in existence as of the writing of this post… probably.

[h1]How to Train Your Luchador[/h1]

As we were making Guacamelee! 2, it occurred to us that all of the new abilities we were adding would require extensive training for players to properly master. So, we recruited a batch of mostly competent and somewhat knowledgeable characters to fill the role.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/e0b17ea3f222934b6541b50cf8c0f812995cba4f.jpg[/img]

As players progress through the world of Guacamelee! 2, they’ll encounter ability trainers. Each of these trainers has a specialty that they focus on. Complete trainer challenges and they’ll hook you up with powerful upgrades and cool new abilities.

Climb to the peak of fitness with Doña Chamoya or sharpen your beak under the tutelage of Rooster Ramírez. Upgrade your grappling moves with Coscorrona or decipher Uay Coco’s instructions to punch with explosive force!

However, if you really want to fight with finesse, visit Flame Face in one of his many tequila bar franchises and go toe-to-toe against punching Poncho (don’t hold back, he’s paid well for the job).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/d3c50b146d9885652f28744bc7b945d750cb4804.jpg[/img]

[h1]A Bigger Game than Ever Before[/h1]

Guacamelee! 2 is an epic adventure that can be experienced alone or co-operatively with three of your closest amigos. Explore hundreds of new platforming and combat challenges. New abilities such as Eagle Boost, Rocket Kick, GOOOTCHA! and more add to Juan’s awesome arsenal of luchador moves. Upgrade your pollo form with Pollo Shot, Pollo Slide and a plethora of new chicken abilities (some secret, some not so secret). Select strategically from dozens of new skill upgrades to maximize your lucha potential.

So how did we plan to squeeze all of this into a game the size of Guacamelee! ? We didn’t! Thanks to our poor planning, we were forced to create a much larger game than the original. You can expect a bigger, badder world, with all sorts of interesting nooks and crannies to explore and conquer.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32471456/3dcb382dad20f883d276f4d660c1fc8a46072f13.jpg[/img]

We’ve worked extremely hard on the game over the past two years, and we’re super hyped that people will finally be able to experience Guacamelee! 2 so soon. Please feel free to ask any questions you have in the comments below, and we will try to answer them the best we can!

Oh... and please Wishlist us! (if you wish)
